card.name: Words just before 'interval' in dosing
card.fires_on: Small words or spots right before the word 'interval(s)' or a repeat-schedule phrase, such as 'at' after 'repeated' or 'more' before 'frequently'. Seen in dosing and monitoring schedules.

modes.label: 'at' before intervals
modes.description: The word 'at' after 'repeated' or 'increments', where 'intervals' comes next.
modes.example: injections may be repeated<< at>> eight hour intervals, if necessary.

modes.label: 'more' before 'frequently'
modes.description: The word 'more' in 'monthly or more frequently', pointing to how often something is done.
modes.example: then monthly or<< more>> frequently if dosage alterations or other therapy changes

modes.label: Spots in schedule tables
modes.description: A gap or hyphenated piece in a dosing interval table or 'every X-week' phrase.

card.writes: It pushes the model to write 'interval' or 'intervals' (and the Chinese words for 'every' and 'interval') next.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say 'at intervals' or how often a dose or test is repeated.
